text:
Asha: Hey team — quick handoff. I'm coming off shift in 15. Current state: embeddings-prod has been throwing 503s intermittently for ~40m, error rate ~7% and latency spiking. We're currently P1 in the incident runbook.
Asha: I'm primary right now, but need to hand driving to whoever's taking the next shift. Priya is marked as secondary but she's on PTO today and hasn't responded to pings. There's a coverage gap if no one picks up.
Asha: TL;DR what needs to be done: (1) own the bridge + mitigation actions, (2) own comms (customer updates + #status) until we have a stable rollback or fix, (3) coordinate with infra if we need to scale pools or roll back to previous model quantization.
Asha: Quick context + what's been tried: autoscaler tried one burst, didn't bring latency down due to cold KV cache. We rolled an emergency config to reduce batch size from 64 -> 32 around 12:05 UTC, slight latency improvement but errors persisted. No code deploys in the last 2 hours.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 created 1809123400 - embeddings-prod elevated error rate. Pager sent to oncall rotation. Current severity: degraded with customer impact.
Jared: I'm coming online now, can take driver if needed. Are there any open tasks you want to hand off immediately? @Asha
Asha: Thanks @Jared. Immediate tasks: 1) join the bridge (call 1-555-0123), 2) follow runbook section "embeddings-prod -> error spikes" (link: https://internal/runbooks/embeddings#error-spikes), 3) try a controlled restart of the smallest worker pool if KV-hit ratio is high (we measured ~0.9 KV-miss ratio).
Asha: Runbook excerpt pasted here for visibility:
```
# embeddings-prod error spikes
check-kv: curl -sS https://infra/metrics/kv-miss | jq .miss_ratio
if miss_ratio > 0.7:
  - reduce_batch_size: current 64 -> 32
  - restart_pool: worker-pool-3 (rolling)
  - monitor: 5m windows for error_rate and latency
escalate: infra@redwood if restart_pool doesn't reduce error_rate by 0.5% within 10m
```
Priya: Sorry missed earlier pings, was in a meeting. I'm logged in now but can't stay >30m. Can't be primary. Happy to be hot-secondary for comms if needed for the first 15.
Samir: I can own comms (customer-facing updates and #status). I'll draft the first update: "We're aware of elevated errors for embeddings; mitigation in progress; next update in 20 mins." Want me to post now?
Jared: I'll take driver. Joining bridge. Asha, can you hand me any private debugging keys or session links? Also, what's the cluster name for restarting? I see worker-pool-3 in runbook, confirm.
Asha: Yes, cluster is embeddings-prod-eu1, pool is worker-pool-3. Sharing session link in DM. Keys: ephemeral session created under your user, expires in 1h. Also note: throttles are enabled on the edge; you might need to temporarily lift burst limits for controlled restart (don't exceed 2x current qps). See policy: https://internal/policies/throttles#allowed-burst
oncall-rotation-bot: @Jared has been assigned primary for the next shift window (1809123600 - 1809150000). @Samir assigned comms. Reminder: update oncall status page after takeover.
Jared: Got it. Taking driver. Samir — please post the update now, + call out affected endpoints and any mitigations in progress.
Samir: Posted to #status and sent the customer note draft to #customer-notify for review. Draft: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting embeddings in EU. Our engineers are performing controlled restarts and monitoring. No data was exposed. We'll update in 20 minutes or sooner." Please react with :eyes: if you approve.
Asha: :thumbsup: looks good. One more thing — if the restart doesn't help in 15 mins, next step per runbook is to fallback traffic to embeddings-backup (previous quantized model). That requires coordination with traffic-router (tag: @infra-team). Who can ping infra if needed?
Jared: I can escalate to infra if the restart fails. I'll also open an incident ticket with infra and paste the link here.
Priya: For coverage gap: I can extend 15 extra minutes if needed, but need to leave by 15:30. @Jared if you need a second pair of hands quickly ping me and I'll jump back in.
Samir: Update 10m in: restart_pool-3 in progress. Monitoring dashboards show slight latency improvement, error rate down to 4.2% from 7%. Keeping watch.
Jared: Noted. I'll keep driving. Logging actions: restart initiated by Jared at 1809123550, restart complete 1809123590. Monitoring window open.
Samir: New customer note posted with rollback plan included. :white_check_mark:
Asha: Thank you all — passing formal ownership. Jared = primary driver, Samir = comms owner, Priya = short secondary coverage backup. I'll update my calendar and the shift notes.
Jared: Acknowledged. Taking full ownership. I'll update last_message_ts after stabilization. Thanks Asha for the handover.
Samir: Thanks Asha. Ping if you want me to loop legal for customer messages.
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 update logged 1809123710 - error rate 3.8% after restart. Continue monitoring.
Jared: Closing handoff thread. I'll post final status when we hit stable <1% error rate for 15 minutes.
Asha: Thanks — enjoy the rest of your shift. :coffee:
